Explosions at Factories in Tamil Nadu and Assam Kill at Least 5

An explosion occurred at an illegal fireworks warehouse in Sivakasi, Tamil Nadu, resulting in three deaths and multiple injuries. Separately, an explosion at a rod manufacturing factory in Assam killed four laborers. Another incident at a fireworks factory in Saharanpur left several people injured.
